beats.statement: The court of Aino assembles to open the show.
Aino decrees that the Friday bottle and the throne go to the last contestant standing. The court proclaims it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In a realm of dust and ambition, a crown gathers dust.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Who dares to want my bottle? Come, then.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: New rules: no sulking, no mercy, no refunds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody dares to ask what the old rules were.

lines.speaker: p19
lines.text: I would have done it with more style.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Kirsi, you are banished. Today.

lines.speaker: p19
lines.text: You cannot do this!

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Crown says I can.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hear the prophecy, little ones!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One who bears the sign of the Stag...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One who faces a Fool at the last...

lines.speaker: p12
lines.text: That could be anyone!

lines.speaker: p24
lines.text: And this is why I never sit near the door.

lines.speaker: p25
lines.text: One name. One coin. No questions.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The name on the parchment reads: Elina.

lines.speaker: p30
lines.text: Is it always like this around here?

lines.speaker: p24
lines.text: I only borrowed a little crown money.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Vault exiles Minna with interest.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: I fear no shadows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A shadow politely disagrees. Elina is out.

lines.speaker: p15
lines.text: Together we rise, Öhman.

lines.speaker: p40
lines.text: Together. Until it is inconvenient.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They shake on it. Both count their fingers after.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Green fire bursts from the cellars.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Niko, Sanna and 3 more are lost in the blaze.

lines.speaker: p30
lines.text: Run!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ghost of Elina has come to watch.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: Mind the step. I did not.

lines.speaker: p28
lines.text: Welcome, friends! Lock the doors.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The music stops. The doors do not open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Aino, Cecilia and 2 more never leave the hall.

lines.speaker: p40
lines.text: Watch my back, friend.

lines.speaker: p15
lines.text: Oh, I am watching it closely.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Öhman's rod snaps. The alliance is over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Blue eyes glow beyond the ice wall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The cold takes Bea, Fredrik and 3 more.

lines.speaker: p10
lines.text: I am not built for winter!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Green fire bursts from the cellars.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Joonas, Jääskeläinen and 3 more are lost in the blaze.

lines.speaker: p13
lines.text: Run!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The rope bridge creaks. Then it does not.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hannu, Inka and 2 more drop into the gorge.

lines.speaker: p14
lines.text: A toast to you, Pekka!

lines.speaker: p28
lines.text: How kind! It tastes of almonds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The goblet rolls across the table.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A recruiter with a big smile arrives.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Aleksi, Daniel and 3 more sign up before reading the small print.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two banners, one very muddy field.

lines.speaker: p35
lines.text: Hold the line!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Iiro, Jari and 3 more fall in the muck.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A falling gargoyle misses Urho by a hair.

lines.speaker: p35
lines.text: I meant to do that!

lines.speaker: p35
lines.text: Ha! Missed me!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The arrow quivers in the post behind Urho.

lines.speaker: p35
lines.text: Only one of us leaves this place, Saku.

lines.speaker: p30
lines.text: Then I will hold the door for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Steel rings. The rival's rod snaps. It is over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Urho falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so the prophecy is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: p30
lines.text: The bottle is mine!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Take good care of it.

chronicle.epilogue: When the dust settled, Saku the Brute sat upon the Bottle Throne. 39 rivals fell, fled or were sent away along the way. The old crown passed on, the prophecy came true, and the bottle was finally opened. Long may Saku reign, at least until next Friday.
